newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Dell shrs lower after Q2.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Dell shrs lower after Q2.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp shares slipped in after hours trading Tuesday, following the company's release of second quarter results.
Dealers said shares of the Texas-based computer maker traded at 84, off of a close of 84-5/8.
Dell, the leading direct seller of computers, reported second quarter earnings of $0.59 a share on net sales of $2.81 billion, up from year-ago figures.
Wall Street had expected the company to pull in $0.54 a share in the quarter, according to First Call.
As trading continued after-hours, Dell shares rose to 84-1/4, waffling near its Tuesday closing price.
One dealer said Dell shares inched higher later to 85.
Earlier Tuesday a rally in technology stocks sent Nasdaq shares up almost two percent, or around 31 points, to an unofficial close of 1601.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had volume of 55,900, compared with 61,000 Monday and session two had volume of 5.9 million, compared with no activity Monday.
